aboutText: Based in Airport West, we specialise in test and tag services for Melbourne CBD, North, and West suburbs. With AS/NZS 3760 certification, we deliver audit-ready reports and compliance management, including same-day results and a next-due tracker. Serving construction sites, offices, and warehouses, our certified technicians ensure workplace safety with quick, reliable service.
servicesText: We offer a range of test and tag services to keep your workplace safe and compliant. From initial audits to ongoing tracking, our certified technicians handle it all efficiently.

services.title: Appliance Test & Tag
services.desc: Comprehensive testing and tagging of electrical appliances to ensure safety and compliance with AS/NZS 3760 standards.

services.title: RCD Safety Switch Testing
services.desc: Professional testing and certification of residual current devices to prevent electrical hazards in your workplace.

services.title: Site Compliance Audits
services.desc: Full electrical safety audits conducted on-site to identify risks and ensure your business meets all regulatory requirements.

services.title: 48-Hour Compliance Start
services.desc: Quick initiation of compliance processes with certified technicians on-site within 48 hours for immediate peace of mind.

services.title: Audit-Ready Reports
services.desc: Detailed reports delivered same day, formatted for audits and inspections to streamline your compliance documentation.

services.title: Next-Due Tracker
services.desc: Set-and-forget tracking system that manages compliance deadlines and sends reminders, so you never miss a re-test date.
